sources.entry: Aurcue - AI personal aesthetic assistant that turns one photo into practical guidance for colors, outfits, hairstyles, glasses, and daily style decisions.

summary.name: Aurcue
summary.one_liner: Aurcue is an AI personal style assistant that analyzes a photo of you (face or outfit) to suggest colors, makeup, hairstyles, glasses, nails, outfits, and seasonal looks.
use_cases: Choosing a color palette for clothes and makeup
Getting hairstyle ideas to bring to a salon
Finding glasses frames that suit your face
Reviewing an outfit to see what to change
Getting nail design ideas for a salon visit
summary.what_it_does: The site offers a set of photo-based reports. Users upload one face photo for color, makeup, hairstyle, glasses, nail, or facial aesthetic analysis, or an outfit or half/full-body photo for outfit analysis, lookbooks, seasonal streetwear guides, and fashion magazine style reports. Outputs listed include season signals, palettes, makeup and blush placement, face-shape cues, frame shapes, nail shape and finish, and eight-look lookbooks. The facial aesthetic report gives a score out of 100 with six feature scores. Several reports mention a salon-ready brief or shopping item lists.
notable: Covers many style areas (color, makeup, hair, glasses, nails, outfits) from one photo upload
Facial aesthetic score out of 100 with six feature scores and styling tips
Outputs salon-ready briefs for hair and nails
caveats: Pricing and any paid tiers are not stated on the page
Each report requires uploading a personal photo of face or body
